not_claimed: A way of noting decisions; it does not show that noting them helps a reader (no study with people). Disclosure helps a reader repeat the work but does not by itself settle whether a reading is valid or a choice biased. The column of who judged names the judgement made, not the viewers of the paper; 'none recorded' means no look was judged with a sheet, not that the makers did not look. The six rows are chosen by the rule above, not as the decisions that mattered most. The reasons are the makers' statements as recorded in the decision table; they are not checked against a file and do not show that a choice was right. The judged cells of work 2 speak of the row of the 20 words only (the other rows of the blind judgement are in S1); they were judged on the images of the judgement (80 px tiles under five common seeds), not on figure 6 itself. The share used is a record of the words and sentences of the works, counted after their values and images were seen: the middle half of f and s of the 104 sentences of work 1, set next to the story's own matched terms shuffled among its sentences, each sentence keeping its number of matched terms, and to random sentences with the same numbers of matched terms, drawn uniformly from its lexicon (the same unit; each share beside is the mean over 1000 replicates; the shuffles keep which terms the story uses and how often, and break which terms share a sentence; the uniform draws break both), and of the 120 words of the main images of work 2 under map B, set next to the whole Japanese lexicon and to the distinct words of the 23 works, each once (version 14; version 13 showed them weighted by their running tokens, each author weighing 1, which narrowed them to 6%, 9%), through the same map B, and under the percentiles next to the same distinct words (under the percentiles the middle half is about half by construction only with the weights of the reference), not a property of the map or of the lexicon (the shares on the other reference sets, the matched terms of work 1 and the minimum to maximum are in S1); the shares of the whole lexicon and of the words of the 23 works are read from their records and not computed again from the values (versions 13 and 14); the draws of 20 words per author, from all distinct words and from those passing the filter of the selection, are in the text and S1, not in the figure (version 14); the random sentences draw every term of the lexicon with the same chance, which no text does; using more of a range is not claimed to be better, and the share says nothing of how reliable the values are. 'Shown beside' names an alternative drawn next to the chosen one after the decision; 'Later compared with' names an alternative, or a set shown beside the value ('those beside', version 13), computed after the decision; neither is a reason of the decision. The judged of the seed speaks of the version that changes the seed and the color together (SPC); the seed alone was not judged ('not apart from color', version 13).
